beats.text: Two robot joints get the same command at the same time.
beats.zh: 两个机器人关节，在同一时刻收到同样的命令。

beats.text: Will they really move at the same moment?
beats.zh: 它们真的会在同一瞬间动起来吗？

beats.text: This course is about EtherCAT, the bus inside many robot joints.
beats.zh: 这门课讲 EtherCAT，很多机器人关节里用的就是这条总线。

beats.text: Before how it works, one question: why does timing matter so much?
beats.zh: 讲它怎么工作之前，先回答一个问题：为什么时间这么要紧？

beats.text: Every episode uses the same small line.
beats.zh: 每一集都用同一条小总线。

beats.text: One master, then three slaves on one cable.
beats.zh: 一个主站，后面一根网线串着三个从站。

beats.text: Master: the controller that sends commands. Slave: a device that obeys and reports.
beats.zh: 主站：发命令的控制器。从站：听命令、回数据的设备。

beats.text: Slave 1 is an analog input card. Slaves 2 and 3 are joint drives, J1 and J2.
beats.zh: 从站 1 是模拟量采集卡，从站 2 和 3 是两个关节驱动器：J1、J2。

beats.text: The master is real open-source code, SOEM. The slaves are simulated chips.
beats.zh: 主站是真实的开源代码 SOEM，从站是模拟出来的芯片。

beats.text: Every number in this course comes from running it.
beats.zh: 这门课里的每个数字，都来自真实运行。

beats.text: Every 1 ms, the master sends J1 and J2 a new target position.
beats.zh: 主站每 1 毫秒给 J1、J2 发一个新的目标位置。

beats.text: Both follow the same slow wave, so they should always be in the same place.
beats.zh: 两个关节走同一条缓慢的正弦曲线，所以它们应该永远在同一个位置。

scenes.title: Error = speed × time
scenes.zh: 误差 = 速度 × 时间

beats.text: A moving joint does not wait for you.
beats.zh: 运动中的关节不会等你。

beats.text: Apply a target late, and the joint is behind by speed × lateness.
beats.zh: 目标晚一点生效，关节就落后：落后量 = 速度 × 晚了多久。

beats.text: A machine tool at F1000 moves 1000 mm per minute: about 16.7 mm per second.
beats.zh: 机床走 F1000：每分钟 1000 毫米，约每秒 16.7 毫米。

beats.text: 1 ms late: 16.7 mm/s × 0.001 s ≈ 0.017 mm, about 17 µm.
A robot joint turning 180° per second: 1 ms late is 0.18°.
beats.zh: 机器人关节每秒转 180°：晚 1 毫秒就是 0.18°。

beats.text: At the end of a 0.5 m arm, 0.18° is about 1.6 mm.
beats.zh: 在 0.5 米长的手臂末端，0.18° 约等于 1.6 毫米。

beats.text: For a moving machine, a timing error is a position error.
beats.zh: 对运动中的机器来说，时间误差就是位置误差。

beats.text: Timing can go wrong in two different ways.
beats.zh: 时间可以错在两个地方。

beats.text: Skew: within one cycle, J1 and J2 act at different moments.
beats.zh: 偏差（skew）：同一个周期里，J1 和 J2 动作的时刻不一样。

beats.text: Jitter: the cycle itself wobbles. 1 ms becomes 0.8, then 1.2.
beats.zh: 抖动（jitter）：周期本身在晃。1 毫秒一会儿变 0.8，一会儿变 1.2。

beats.text: Skew makes the joints disagree with each other.
beats.zh: 偏差让关节之间对不上。

beats.text: Jitter makes the whole motion stumble, even when the joints agree.
beats.zh: 抖动让整个动作磕磕绊绊，哪怕关节彼此一致。

beats.text: Like a band that plays together, but follows a conductor whose beat wobbles.
beats.zh: 像一支乐队：大家彼此很齐，但指挥的拍子忽快忽慢。

beats.text: Send each motor its command in turn, and the first moves before the last one hears.
beats.zh: 如果挨个给电机发命令，第一个已经动了，最后一个才收到。

beats.text: That is skew. CANopen's CSP mode fixes it with one broadcast.
beats.zh: 这就是偏差。CANopen 的 CSP 模式用一条广播来解决。

beats.text: First each drive gets its target. Then one SYNC message, ID 0x80, says: everyone, go.
beats.zh: 先把目标分别发给每个驱动器，再发一条 SYNC 报文（ID 0x80）：大家一起动。

beats.text: One message reaches every drive together, so skew is small.
beats.zh: 一条报文同时到达所有驱动器，偏差就小了。

beats.text: But when does SYNC leave? When the master's software timer fires.
beats.zh: 但 SYNC 什么时候发出？取决于主站的软件定时器。

beats.text: If the bus is busy, SYNC waits. One 8-byte CAN frame takes about 0.1 ms at 1 Mbit/s.
beats.zh: 总线正忙，SYNC 就得等。1 Mbit/s 下，一个 8 字节的 CAN 帧约要 0.1 毫秒。

beats.text: Then each drive reacts through an interrupt, which adds its own delay.
beats.zh: 每个驱动器还要经过中断才响应，又添一段延迟。

beats.text: So SYNC fixes skew, not jitter. Every drive inherits the master's wobble.
beats.zh: 所以 SYNC 治了偏差，治不了抖动：每个驱动器都继承了主站的晃动。

beats.text: Back on our line. First, the drives act the moment new targets arrive.
beats.zh: 回到我们的总线。先让驱动器在新目标到达的那一刻动作。

beats.text: The master tries to send exactly every 1 ms.
beats.zh: 主站尽量每 1 毫秒准时发一次。

beats.text: Guess: how far from 1 ms will the real cycles land?
beats.zh: 猜一猜：实际的周期会偏离 1 毫秒多少？

beats.text: 3 seconds of running: about 2,500 cycles measured at J1.
beats.zh: 运行 3 秒：在 J1 上测到约 2500 个周期。

beats.text: Most cycles stay near 1 ms. But some come hundreds of microseconds early or late.
beats.zh: 大多数周期在 1 毫秒附近，但总有一些早到或晚到几百微秒。

beats.text: The spread, one standard deviation, is tens of microseconds, in every run.
beats.zh: 离散程度（一个标准差）每次运行都是几十微秒。

beats.text: The wobble comes from the master: an ordinary Mac, not a real-time system.
beats.zh: 这些晃动来自主站：一台普通的 Mac，不是实时系统。

beats.text: A real-time OS makes it much smaller, but never zero.
beats.zh: 换成实时操作系统能小很多，但永远不会是零。

beats.text: Now J1 against J2: they act 310 ns apart, in every cycle.
beats.zh: 再看 J1 和 J2 之间：每个周期都相差 310 纳秒。

beats.text: 310 ns is the simulated cable and chip delay. One frame passes J1, then J2.
beats.zh: 310 纳秒是模拟的网线加芯片延迟：同一帧先经过 J1，再经过 J2。

beats.text: So skew is tiny. Episode 3 shows how one frame does that.
beats.zh: 所以偏差很小。一帧怎么做到这一点，第 3 集再讲。

beats.text: But the jitter goes straight through to the motors.
beats.zh: 可是抖动原封不动地传给了电机。

beats.text: At 180°/s, a cycle 0.2 ms late leaves J1 0.036° behind: about 0.3 mm at the arm tip.
beats.zh: 以每秒 180° 计，晚到 0.2 毫秒的周期让 J1 落后 0.036°，在手臂末端约 0.3 毫米。

beats.text: Same line, one change: each drive acts on its own clock.
beats.zh: 同一条总线，只改一处：每个驱动器按自己的时钟动作。

beats.text: Every slave chip has a clock. EtherCAT keeps all those clocks in step.
beats.zh: 每个从站芯片里都有一个时钟。EtherCAT 让这些时钟步调一致。

beats.text: This is called the Distributed Clock, DC for short.
beats.zh: 这叫分布式时钟（Distributed Clock），简称 DC。

beats.text: Every 1 ms by its own clock, each drive fires a pulse called SYNC0, and acts on it.
beats.zh: 每个驱动器按自己的时钟，每 1 毫秒产生一个叫 SYNC0 的脉冲，就在这一刻动作。

beats.text: The frame only has to arrive before SYNC0. Exactly when no longer matters.
beats.zh: 帧只要在 SYNC0 之前到就行，具体哪一刻到已经无所谓。

beats.text: Same master, same Mac, the sending still wobbles.
beats.zh: 主站还是那台 Mac，发送照样在晃。

beats.text: Cycle spread at the drives: about 5 ns, in every run.
beats.zh: 驱动器上的周期离散：约 5 纳秒，每次运行都一样。

beats.text: Once the clocks settle, J1 and J2 act within about 10 ns of each other.
beats.zh: 时钟稳定下来以后，J1 和 J2 动作的时刻相差在 10 纳秒左右。

beats.text: From tens of microseconds to a few nanoseconds: about ten thousand times tighter.
beats.zh: 从几十微秒到几纳秒：大约收紧了一万倍。

beats.text: Note: how fast the clocks settle comes from our simulated chip, not a real one.
beats.zh: 注意：时钟多快能稳定，取决于我们模拟的芯片，不是某款真实芯片的数据。

beats.text: Getting there takes four questions, one at a time.
beats.zh: 要做到这一点，需要回答四个问题，一个一个来。

beats.text: How is one cable already a ring? Episode 2.
beats.zh: 一根网线，怎么就已经是一个环？第 2 集。

beats.text: How does one frame serve every slave without stopping? Episode 3.
beats.zh: 一帧怎么不停下来，就服务了每一个从站？第 3 集。

beats.text: How does the line start up and agree who sends what? Episode 4.
beats.zh: 总线怎么启动，怎么约定谁收发哪些数据？第 4 集。

beats.text: How do clocks in different chips agree to a few nanoseconds? Episode 5.
beats.zh: 不同芯片里的时钟，怎么对齐到几纳秒？第 5 集。

beats.text: One: for a moving machine, timing error is position error. Speed × time.
beats.zh: 一、对运动中的机器，时间误差就是位置误差：速度 × 时间。

beats.text: Two: skew and jitter differ. One is between joints, the other is the beat itself.
beats.zh: 二、偏差和抖动是两回事：一个在关节之间，一个是节拍本身。

beats.text: Three: acting when a message arrives inherits the sender's jitter. A shared clock removes it.
beats.zh: 三、收到报文就动作，会继承发送方的抖动；共享的时钟才能去掉它。

beats.text: A joint turns at 90° per second. One cycle arrives 0.3 ms late.
beats.zh: 一个关节每秒转 90°，某个周期晚到了 0.3 毫秒。

beats.text: How far behind is it, in degrees?
beats.zh: 它落后了多少度？

beats.text: Next: one cable, and why it is already a ring.
beats.zh: 下一集：一根网线，为什么它已经是一个环。
